fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Motorized infantry travel on light unarmored vehicles that allow them to cover ground faster than the foot platoons that make up the bulk of DCMS garrison forces. District regulars rely on motorized platoons for security patrols across large garrison zones, forward observation, and the rapid response that foot troops cannot provide when trouble arises between widely separated posts. Carrying light ballistic weapons that sacrifice stopping power for reduced weight. The tradeoff favors endurance over firepower, allowing these troops to cover more ground on extended patrols than standard rifle platoons. Configured as light infantry, these troops carry reduced weapon loads that allow faster movement and longer patrols. They trade firepower for endurance and a lower detection signature, suited to screening operations where staying hidden matters more than hitting hard.
